title: Long Rail Rowing Machine
description: Original static low-poly indoor rowing machine with a 1.84m longitudinal rail, independent chamfered saddle and a captured four-roller carriage. Two upper rollers and two lower capture rollers engage the rail in one stored pose; external carrier cheeks have actual lateral clearance, with physical front and rear stops. Two inclined foot trays have raised heel edges and true open arch straps. A separate transverse pull handle rests on a solid cradle and connects to the front resistance enclosure by a fixed cord. The front unit has a thick annular enclosure, separately editable inner wheel, radial protective grilles, central hub and bearing-style caps. Front and rear crossfeet terminate in four finite ground pads. Six solid flat PBR materials, no textures, characters or imported seat geometry. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, origin on the ground under rail centreline. One original reusable prop. Static stylized visual only: no exercise prescription, body-fit guarantee, resistance/power specification, continuous sliding/rope controller, load rating or safety certification.
